title: amicode studio manifest
description: The manifest that binds an Amicode installation (#402): one file (~/.amicode/config.toml) declaring the studio root, the ordered vault mount stack, and the roots for catalog/ledger/harness/packs. Research capital lives under the studio root (visible, git-syncable); engine state lives in the dotdir. Absent manifest = exactly today's behavior (the fallback ladder) — never brick. Deliberately NOT filename-kinded: 'config.toml' is too generic a name to claim; validate via --schema. Structural checks only — semantic checks (exactly one rw personal mount, drift) belong to `amicode doctor`.

studio_root.description: the visible studio root (default ~/armonia); ~ allowed; every derived root defaults beneath it

mounts.description: the ordered mount stack — document order IS precedence (first rw personal wins writes by kind)

kind.description: the vault kind — write-routing and precedence key (matches the mount-stack resolver)

ledger.description: the event log of the science (runs.jsonl, campaign books); default <studio_root>/ledger

harness.description: harness session logs (telaio tenants) — the warrant audit trail; default <studio_root>/ledger/harness

packs_external.description: the external pack root (second resolution root after the bundled packs); default <studio_root>/packs

problems.description: the problem workspaces (design records); default <studio_root>/problems — set explicitly while an install still lives on a legacy layout (doctor flags the drift)

runs.description: local compute output (run dirs) — retained, never synced; default <studio_root>/runs

vaults_root.description: the directory mounts' relative paths resolve against; default <studio_root>/vaults
